approval: Standing independently inspected positive-reference cut-off allocation-supply helper pattern, as used for reclaimed HFC-134a and blast-furnace-gas allocated supply. Independent read-only inspection of all fourteen installed ecoinvent backgrounds establishes each exact Recycled Content cut-off stock has only a self-linked +1 production exchange. This observation preserves the source allocation boundary; no zero footprint for actual recycling, treatment, other profiles or uncharacterized flows is inferred.
